# TM Repository Pre-Publication Checklist

Before publishing any repository under `tmolavi`, verify every item:

- [ ] **Repository Name:** Uses standardized `tm-*` prefix (unless documented exemption).
- [ ] **Description:** Descriptive, concise, search-engine-optimized, and includes relevant keywords.
- [ ] **Topics/Tags:** Tagged with relevant keywords (`ai-agents`, `geo`, `seo`, `open-source`, `molavi`).
- [ ] **README.md:** International open-source standard with badges, quickstart, and language switcher.
- [ ] **Five Languages:** `docs/fa/README.md`, `docs/tr/README.md`, `docs/az/README.md`, `docs/ar/README.md`.
- [ ] **License:** Valid MIT license file present.
- [ ] **Model Transparency:** `MODEL-REQUIREMENTS.md` with token budget and free-first alternative.
- [ ] **Security:** `SECURITY.md` detailing permission level.
- [ ] **Code Provenance:** `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` documenting upstream libraries.
- [ ] **Automated CI:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` running tests and governance check.
- [ ] **Zero Secrets:** Repository history scanned for tokens or sensitive keys.
- [ ] **Hamzad Integration:** Relevance to Hamzad AI ecosystem assessed.
